mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT a.VENDOR_ID vendorId, a.VENDOR_CODE vendorCode, v.COMPANY_NAME vendorName, a.APPLY_PHONE phone, a.APPLY_EMAIL email, a.APPLY_CONTACT_NAME linkmanName, v.FOCUS_FLAG extIsMainPoint, '寻源需求' sourceType FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_req_head h JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_req_apply a ON h.REQ_HEAD_ID = a.REQ_HEAD_ID AND a.APPLY_STATUS='SUCCESS_SIGNUP' JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_demand d ON d.APPLICANT_NO = h.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_NO AND d.PROJECT_ID=#{projectId} JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier.scc_sup_company_info v ON v.COMPANY_ID = a.VENDOR_ID
UNION SELECT distinct v.COMPANY_ID vendorId, v.COMPANY_CODE vendorCode, v.COMPANY_NAME vendorName, i.CEEA_CONTACT_METHOD phone, i.EMAIL email, CONTACT_NAME linkmanName, v.FOCUS_FLAG extIsMainPoint, '供应商库' sourceType FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier.scc_sup_org_category c LEFT JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier.scc_sup_company_info v ON v.COMPANY_ID = c.COMPANY_ID LEFT JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier.scc_sup_contact_info i ON i.COMPANY_ID = v.COMPANY_ID WHERE c.COMPANY_STATUS IN ('IMPORTING', 'QUALIFIED') and c.CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode} AND c.PJ_ORG_STATUS='Y' and v.TIME_LIMIT_FLAG = 'N' and v.IS_BACKLIST = 'N' and v.PJ_COMPANY_STATUS IN ('QUASI_SUPPLIER', 'OFFICIAL_SUPPLIER') ) t
and t.vendorCode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vendorCode}, '%') and t.vendorName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vendorName}, '%')
GROUP BY t.vendorId ORDER BY sourceType DESC

select.foreach: select * from ( SELECT p.PROJECT_ID, p.EXT_PROJECT_NO, p.SOU_NAME, p.EXT_CATEGORY_ID, p.PROJECT_STATUS, d.vendor_id, d.vendor_code, d.vendor_name FROM scc_sou_project p JOIN scc_npm_sou_bid_notice n ON n.project_id = p.PROJECT_ID AND n.type = 'APPLY' AND n.`status` = 'APPROVED' AND n.creation_date > #{item.creationDate} JOIN scc_npm_sou_bid_notice_detail d ON d.bid_notice_id = n.bid_notice_id AND d.is_win = 'Y' WHERE p.SOU_TYPE = 'bid' AND p.PROJECT_STATUS IN ( 'ARCHIVE_TODO', 'ARCHIVE_DONE' ) AND p.EXT_CATEGORY_ID = #{item.extCategoryId} ORDER BY p.PROJECT_ID DESC LIMIT 10 ) t
